name: @grapix/playout-workspace
description: GrapiX Playout workspace: operator UI, control service and desktop shell.

scripts.build: npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/shared-workspace && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/playout-control && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/playout-web
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/shared-workspace && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/playout-control && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/playout-web && npm --prefix .. run check -w @grapix/playout-desktop
scripts.verify: npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/shared-workspace && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/playout-control && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/playout-web && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/playout-desktop
